qso-voice.title: Your first voice contact
qso-voice.prompt: Choose what you'd say or do at each turn.

turns.situation: You've found a clear frequency, 14.230 MHz, and listened for a while: no one's there. Which sideband?

options.feedback: Lower sideband is used on 40 m and below. 20 m uses upper.
Amateurs use single sideband for voice on HF.

options.text: "CQ CQ CQ, this is VE3HAM VE3HAM VE3HAM."

options.feedback: Say CQ three times, not once.

options.text: "CQ CQ CQ CQ CQ CQ CQ CQ CQ CQ, this is VE3HAM."
options.feedback: Ten CQs and one call sign is the wrong way round: CQ three times, your call three times.

turns.situation: "VE3HAM, this is VE7ABC." You have a good contact. Next week you hear VE7ABC again and want to call him.

options.feedback: Their call sign, "this is", yours. Have a good contact!
Put their call sign first, then "this is" and yours.
CQ is for any station. To call someone specific, use their call sign.

qso-voice.success: Their call sign, "this is", yours. Have a good contact!
